key: A three-legged stool. Leg 1 says the
name: ch01_three_legged_stool
alt: A wooden three-legged stool holding a seated chart-reader, each leg labelled as one of technical analysis's three premises, with a sawn-off fourth position showing it would topple if a leg were removed.
scene: A centred, slightly low-angle view of a sturdy wooden three-legged stool standing on the cement floor of a small Indian tuition room with a green chalkboard behind. On the stool sits a calm young man in his late 20s, cotton kurta over jeans, spectacles, a laptop balanced on his knees showing a simple rising line, looking confident and relaxed. Each of the three turned wooden legs is wrapped with a small cream paper tag. To the right, in a circular inset bubble, the same stool is shown with one leg snapped and lying on the floor, the man tipping sideways with a startled face and the laptop sliding off, small motion lines and a puff of dust showing the fall. A thin curved arrow runs from the healthy stool to the inset to show the consequence. On the chalkboard in the background are faint chalk sketches of candles and an arrow, nothing readable. Morning light from a barred window on the left casts long soft shadows of the legs across the floor; the mood is steady and slightly instructive. Labels: "PRICE DISCOUNTS ALL" on the tag of the front-left leg, "TRENDS" on the tag of the front-right leg, "HISTORY REPEATS" on the tag of the back leg, all three in small block capitals with thin leader lines.

key: people outside holding umbrellas
name: ch01_umbrellas_mean_rain
alt: A man inside an office looks out a window at a street full of people holding open umbrellas and knows it is raining without checking any weather report.
scene: A view from inside a quiet second-floor office in an Indian city during the monsoon. In the foreground, seen from behind and slightly to the side, a man in his 30s in a light blue formal shirt with rolled sleeves stands at a large glass window, one hand holding a cup of chai, the other resting on the sill; on the desk behind him a folded newspaper with a weather column lies closed and ignored. Through the window, the street below is full of people: a schoolgirl in a navy pinafore with a yellow umbrella, a vegetable seller under a big blue tarpaulin umbrella beside his cart, an office worker with a black umbrella walking fast, two college students sharing a striped umbrella, autorickshaws with their side flaps down. The sky itself is hidden above the window frame, so the rain is only implied by the umbrellas and a few puddles with ripples. A dotted arrow runs from the cluster of umbrellas up toward a small grey cloud icon drawn in an inset bubble at the top right, showing that the umbrellas reveal the hidden cause. Soft grey diffused light, cool blue and green tones with warm skin tones, calm and observant mood. Labels: "PRICE" pointing to the umbrellas on the street, "FUNDAMENTALS" next to the cloud inset.

key: heavy trolley rolling down a
name: ch01_trolley_keeps_rolling
alt: A heavily loaded shopping trolley rolls down a long supermarket aisle, wobbling over small bumps, and keeps going until a shop assistant ahead braces to stop it.
scene: A long, deep perspective shot down a brightly lit Indian supermarket aisle with shelves of rice bags, atta packets, biscuit tins and steel vessels on both sides. In the centre foreground a large metal shopping trolley piled high with sacks of rice, a carton of cooking oil and a watermelon rolls away from the viewer by itself, motion lines behind its wheels. Along the floor are three small objects it passes over: a dropped onion, a flattened cardboard flap and a floor-mat edge; at each one the trolley shows a tiny wobble mark but its path line continues straight. Far down the aisle, near the end cap display, a shop assistant in his early 20s in a green uniform t-shirt and cap plants his feet wide and holds both palms forward, bracing to push back against it, his face focused. A long dashed arrow runs along the floor from the trolley toward him, solid where the trolley has travelled and dotted where it is expected to go. A grandmother in a printed saree to the left watches with mild amusement holding a basket. Clean white overhead tube light, crisp and cheerful mood. Labels: "TREND" above the rolling trolley, "NOISE" beside the small bumps, "REVERSAL NEEDS A PUSH" above the bracing assistant.

key: Watch any crowd queueing for a sale
name: ch01_sale_queue_same_people
alt: A split scene of an old-time crowd and a modern crowd queueing for a sale, showing the same excitement, fear of missing out and panic in both eras.
scene: A wide split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing a crowd outside a cloth shop on a sale day with the same composition. LEFT panel, an old-era street: a sepia-toned scene with a shop sign reading "SALE", men in dhotis and caps, women in nine-yard sarees, a bullock cart parked behind, people pressed against a wooden shutter, one man craning his neck eagerly, a woman clutching a bundle anxiously, a boy squeezing between legs. RIGHT panel, a modern mall entrance: the same "SALE" sign on a glass door, people in t-shirts, kurtis and sneakers holding phones, one man craning his neck in exactly the same pose, a woman clutching a shopping bag with the same anxious face, a teenager squeezing through. Above both crowds float matching small emoji-style thought bubbles: a star for excitement, a running figure for fear of missing out, an empty shelf for panic. A thin dotted line connects each matching face across the divider to show the emotions are identical. Price tags on the shop windows differ between the panels. Warm golden afternoon light in both halves, lively and slightly comic mood. Labels: "THEN" at the top of the left panel, "NOW" at the top of the right panel, "SAME PSYCHOLOGY" centred along the bottom across the divider.

key: If each wave reaches further inland
name: ch02_tide_wave_marks
alt: A man on a beach places sticks in the wet sand where each successive wave reaches, and the sticks step further inland, showing the tide is coming in.
scene: A side-on view of a wide Indian beach in the evening, like a Konkan or Chennai shoreline, the sea on the left and dry sand on the right. A man in his 50s with a grey moustache, half-sleeve white shirt, trousers rolled to the knee and bare feet crouches on the sand with a bundle of thin bamboo sticks under his arm, pushing a stick into the wet sand at the furthest point a wave has just reached. Behind him, in a neat diagonal row climbing to the right, four earlier sticks already stand, each one a little further inland than the last, with the foamy edge of each wave's reach drawn as a curved white line at its foot. A small boy of about eight in shorts watches, holding a sandal in one hand. A thin rising arrow runs along the tops of the sticks toward the right. In a small inset bubble at the top right, the same row of sticks is seen later with the newest stick placed lower than the one before it and a downward arrow, showing the tide has turned. Fishing boats sit on the horizon, the setting sun turns the water orange and pink, gentle and contemplative mood. Labels: "PRIMARY TREND" above the rising row of sticks, "TIDE TURNS" inside the inset bubble.

key: a few food critics quietly book tables
name: ch02_restaurant_three_phases
alt: A three-panel story of a new restaurant: critics dining quietly in an empty room, then a long public queue, then early regulars leaving while latecomers crowd in.
scene: A horizontal three-panel strip showing the same small South Indian style restaurant front with a striped awning and a painted signboard, viewed straight on. LEFT panel, early morning: the dining room is nearly empty, with two quiet diners in their 40s in plain shirts, one with a small notebook, eating dosa at a corner table while a bored waiter leans on the counter; chairs are stacked. MIDDLE panel, midday: the same front now has a long queue snaking round the block, families, college students and office workers waiting, one person holding up a newspaper with a star-rating graphic, an excited buzz shown by small sound marks. RIGHT panel, evening: the restaurant is overcrowded with latecomers squeezing in, an aunty phoning someone, people taking selfies at the door, while the two original diners from the left panel walk away out of frame to the right, toward another small eatery in the distance, glancing back with knowing smiles. A thin arrow runs along the bottom of all three panels from left to right. Lighting shifts from cool dawn blue to bright noon to warm orange evening. Labels: "ACCUMULATION" at the top of the left panel, "PUBLIC PARTICIPATION" at the top of the middle panel, "DISTRIBUTION" at the top of the right panel.

key: Factories make goods, railways carry
name: ch02_factory_and_freight_train
alt: A factory busy with output on one side and a freight train hauling its goods on the other, with an inspector checking that both stories agree.
scene: A wide landscape view of an Indian industrial town. On the left, a large brick factory with three tall chimneys puffing white smoke, a loading yard stacked with wooden crates and steel coils, workers in blue overalls and hard hats wheeling hand trucks. On the right, a long freight train of brown wagons pulls along a raised track toward the horizon, its open wagons visibly filled with the same crates and coils, the diesel locomotive in front. Between them, on a small rise in the middle foreground, stands an older inspector in his 60s with a white topi-style cap, khaki safari suit and a clipboard, looking from the factory to the train with a careful, comparing expression; one hand points left, the other right. Two thick arrows rise upward, one above the factory and one above the train, of the same height, showing both are rising together. A small inset bubble in the top right shows the warning case: the factory smoking busily but the train wagons empty, with a red question mark between them. Clear midday sunlight, dusty yellow-brown palette, purposeful mood. Labels: "INDUSTRIALS" above the factory, "TRANSPORTS" above the train, "CONFIRMATION" beside the inspector.

key: Eating a fish: you leave the head
name: ch02_fish_middle_meat
alt: A fried fish on a banana leaf with the head and tail pushed aside, while a diner happily eats the thick middle portion.
scene: A close, slightly overhead view of a lunch table in a Bengali or coastal Kerala home. In the centre a large whole fried fish lies on a green banana leaf beside a mound of rice, a small bowl of curry and a wedge of lime. The middle of the fish is the thick, meaty part and has been neatly opened, with a man's right hand, fingers glistening, lifting a generous piece from it. The man, in his 40s with a vest and a checked lungi, sits cross-legged with a satisfied smile. At the head end, on the left, a fork-like dotted line marks the head as set aside; at the tail end on the right, a thin bony tail lies untouched. Behind him, a smaller inset bubble shows a different diner, a young man hunched over the head end, picking fussily at bones with a pained face and a tiny bone sticking out of his lips, a few loose bones scattered around his plate. A bracket drawn beneath the fish spans only the middle third. Warm afternoon window light, ochre, green and orange tones, homely and humorous mood. Labels: "THE MIDDLE OF THE TREND" above the bracket, "SKIP THE EXTREMES" beside the inset bubble.

key: changes your life far more than going
name: ch03_salary_jump_feels
alt: Two salary hikes of the same rupee amount: a young worker overjoyed at doubling his pay, and a senior manager barely noticing a ten percent rise.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, each half set in a different Indian workplace. LEFT panel: a small shop office with a steel cupboard and a calendar, a young man of about 22 in a plain polo shirt opens a pay envelope, two fat stacks of notes inside, and jumps with both arms up, mouth wide in delight; a pair of thin cream notes on the table beside him is shown doubling into a stack of the same height again, with a bold curved arrow marked by a large step. RIGHT panel: a glass-walled corporate cabin, a manager in his late 40s in a crisp shirt and tie glances at a payslip on his laptop with a mild, polite half-smile while sipping coffee; a tall stack of notes on his desk gains only a thin extra slice on top, with a small flat arrow. Both added slices are drawn with the same thickness and the same colour so the reader sees the rupee amount is identical. Under each panel a short ruler is drawn: on the left the step is long, on the right the same step is tiny. Warm light on the left, cool neutral light on the right, light-hearted and clear mood. Labels: "+100%" above the young man, "+10%" above the manager, "LOG SCALE" centred along the bottom across both panels.

key: how many people were in the stadium
name: ch03_packed_vs_empty_stadium
alt: The same cricket shot hit for six in a packed stadium roaring with fans and in an almost empty stadium with a few scattered spectators.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing the same cricket moment from behind the bowler's end at the same angle: a batsman in whites mid follow-through, the ball arcing over the long-on boundary rope, the electronic scoreboard on the far stand reading the same score. LEFT panel: the stands are packed tier upon tier with fans in blue jerseys, flags waving, horns raised, a sea of raised arms; bold sound lines and confetti burst from the crowd, a boy on his father's shoulders shouting. RIGHT panel: the identical shot, but the stands are almost empty concrete steps with three spectators scattered far apart, one asleep under a newspaper, one eating peanuts, one clapping politely; a lone pigeon sits on a railing and the silence is shown by an empty speech bubble. In both panels a thin dotted arc traces the ball. Small stick-figure counters sit at the bottom of each panel, a crowded row on the left and only three on the right. Bright floodlit evening with a deep blue sky, energetic on the left and flat and quiet on the right. Labels: "HIGH VOLUME" at the top of the left panel, "LOW VOLUME" at the top of the right panel, "SAME PRICE MOVE" centred on the scoreboards.

key: Count the bets still open at a betting
name: ch03_betting_slips_open_interest
alt: At a small betting counter, a clerk counts paper slips each shared by two people on opposite sides, rather than counting every person.
scene: A cosy medium shot of a wooden counter at a village fair, with a hand-painted board behind showing two kabaddi teams, one in red and one in blue. Behind the counter sits a clerk in his 50s with a pencil behind his ear, round glasses and a sleeveless sweater over a white shirt, carefully counting a small tidy pile of pink paper slips with one finger, his lips moving as he counts. In front of the counter stand pairs of people facing each other in friendly rivalry: two farmers in turbans shaking hands, two college girls laughing, two old men with walking sticks, each pair joined by a thin dotted line through a single slip they both hold one end of. One person in each pair wears a red cap and the other a blue cap so the two sides are obvious. A small inset bubble in the top left shows a confused assistant trying to count every head in the crowd with a tally sheet, getting double the number, crossed out with a light red stroke. A thin arrow runs from the pairs down to the clerk's pile. Warm late-afternoon fairground light, bunting overhead, cheerful and orderly mood. Labels: "OPEN INTEREST" above the clerk's pile of slips, "ONE SLIP = BUYER + SELLER" along the bottom near the pairs.

key: A stethoscope records a heartbeat
name: ch03_stethoscope_and_doctor
alt: A stethoscope on a clinic table records a heartbeat, while an experienced doctor beside it does the actual listening and interpreting.
scene: A calm interior of a small neighbourhood clinic in India, with a green curtain, a steel examination bed and a wall poster of a heart. On the left a patient, a middle-aged man in a checked shirt, sits on the bed breathing in deeply. In the centre an experienced female doctor in her 50s with grey-streaked hair in a bun, a white coat over a cotton saree and reading glasses listens through a stethoscope, eyes closed in concentration, one hand raised slightly as if counting. From the chest piece a thin wavy heartbeat line flows up into a speech-bubble-shaped inset above her head, where the same wavy line is shown with a small tick mark beside a healthy rhythm. On the right side of the frame, on a wooden table, lies a second plain stethoscope neatly coiled next to a box of instruments and an open notebook, with a dotted line tying it to the word tag below. A young medical student in a white coat stands behind the doctor, taking notes and watching her face rather than the instrument. Soft daylight through frosted glass, clean whites and calm greens, quiet and respectful mood. Labels: "THE CHART" pointing to the coiled stethoscope on the table, "THE ANALYST" pointing to the listening doctor.

key: climbing a staircase in the dark
name: ch04_dark_staircase_higher_rests
alt: A person climbs a dark staircase holding a small torch, and each resting point and each slip back lands on a higher step than before.
scene: A side cross-section view of a tall concrete staircase inside an old Mumbai chawl building at night, the walls dark blue and only a small circle of torchlight visible. A young man in his 20s in a vest and track pants with a small phone torch climbs carefully, his face focused, one hand on the wall. His path up the stairs is drawn as a zig-zag dotted line: he climbs a few steps, stops to rest, slips back one or two steps, then climbs again. Each place he paused to rest is marked with a small glowing footprint, and each spot he slipped back to is marked with a smaller amber footprint; both rows of footprints step steadily upward from lower left to upper right. Two faint ruled lines are drawn along the tops of the rest marks and the bottoms of the slip marks, both slanting upward. At the top right a dim doorway with light spilling from it hints at the roof. A cat sitting on one landing watches him pass. Deep night blues with warm torch yellow, quiet suspense with a sense of steady progress. Labels: "HIGHER HIGHS" beside the row of glowing rest footprints, "HIGHER LOWS" beside the row of amber slip footprints, "UPTREND" near the doorway at the top.

key: A crowd that bought tickets at
name: ch04_ticket_holders_break_even
alt: People who bought event tickets at one price and saw them fall now crowd a resale counter to sell at their purchase price, turning that price into a ceiling.
scene: A busy street-side ticket resale counter outside a concert venue in an Indian city, viewed in a wide medium shot. On the counter window a hand-painted price board shows the number 100 in large digits. Pressed against the counter is a crowd of tired, relieved-looking people in their 20s and 30s, each holding up a paper ticket; one man in a striped shirt waves his ticket shouting, a woman in a kurti clutches hers with a sigh of relief, a student wipes his forehead. Above their heads float small thought bubbles showing a ticket with 90 crossed out and 100 circled, meaning they just want their money back. Behind the counter, a young buyer who climbed up on a wooden step tries to push upward through a thin horizontal beam drawn at the level of the price board, but the beam is crowded underneath with those sellers' outstretched hands, holding it down. To the left, a small inset bubble shows the earlier moment: the same people happily standing on top of that same beam as if it were a floor. A thin dashed arrow links the inset floor to the present ceiling. Evening street lighting with string bulbs, crowded and slightly frantic mood. Labels: "OLD SUPPORT" in the left inset, "NEW RESISTANCE" along the beam, "BREAK-EVEN SELLERS" above the crowd.

key: Climbing a sand dune: each step up
name: ch04_sand_dune_retracement
alt: A hiker climbing a Thar desert sand dune slides back after each step, with markers showing a normal one-third to one-half slide versus a dangerous two-thirds slide.
scene: A side view of a tall golden sand dune in the Thar desert near Jaisalmer, the slope rising from lower left to upper right. A woman in her 30s wearing a wide cotton hat, a loose long-sleeved shirt, cargo pants and a small backpack climbs the slope, leaning forward, one foot sinking, sand pouring down behind her heel in small streams. Her path is drawn as a dotted line climbing a stretch up, then sliding back down part of the way, then climbing again. Beside her latest slide, a vertical measuring pole is planted in the sand with three coloured bands painted on it: a light band at one third, a slightly darker band at one half, and a red band at two thirds of her last climb. Her slide ends between the first two bands. In a small inset bubble at the upper left, the same woman is shown sliding past the red band all the way to the dune's base with sand billowing, landing seated with a groan. A camel and its handler rest in the shade of a thorny khejri tree at the base. Harsh late-morning sun, long blue shadows, warm ochre palette, effortful mood. Labels: "33-50% RETRACEMENT" beside the light and middle bands, "66% DANGER" beside the red band, "TREND FAILS" inside the inset.

key: the breakaway gap is the jump off
name: ch04_runner_three_gaps
alt: A sprinter in a single race shown at three moments: exploding off the blocks, striding easily mid-track and lunging desperately at the finish, then left alone.
scene: A long horizontal side view of a school athletics track on a dusty Indian maidan, one runner shown at four positions along the same lane like a time-lapse. Far left, at the starting blocks, a lean teenage boy in a red vest with the number 7 explodes forward, a big gap of empty track drawn between his back foot and the blocks with motion streaks. In the middle, the same runner in an easy, long, relaxed stride, airborne between steps, with a clear gap under his feet and a calm face. Near the right, at the finish tape, he makes a desperate lunge, chest thrust out, face strained, arms flung back, a final gap between his last step and the tape. Far right, past the finish, he stands bent over hands on knees, alone on a small patch of track, while groups of spectators and other runners walk away to the left and right on both sides of him, leaving him isolated. Teachers in white with whistles and a crowd of schoolchildren sit on a low wall behind. A thin arrow runs along the lane under all four poses. Bright, hazy afternoon sun, energetic then tired mood. Labels: "BREAKAWAY GAP" above the start, "RUNAWAY GAP" above the mid stride, "EXHAUSTION GAP" above the finish lunge.

key: A top is a crowded party at its loudest
name: ch05_party_top_quiet_bottom
alt: A loud crowded party that empties quickly, compared with a quiet empty hall that slowly fills as guests arrive one by one through the door.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing the same rented community hall with tube lights, plastic chairs and paper streamers. LEFT panel: a packed, noisy party at its peak, people dancing to a DJ with big speakers, a man in a shiny shirt waving his arms, a woman laughing loudly, glasses raised; but at the right side of the panel a stream of guests is already rushing out through the exit door with motion lines, and a sharp downward arrow runs alongside them. RIGHT panel: the same hall almost empty and quiet, chairs neatly lined up, a caretaker sweeping; through the entrance door at the left of the panel guests arrive slowly one at a time, an elderly couple, a family with a child, a young man carrying a gift, each one slightly larger and brighter as more come in. A gentle rising arrow follows the arriving guests, and a small turnstile counter beside the door shows a rising tally of figure icons. Bright saturated party colours on the left, soft dawn tones on the right, contrast of chaos versus calm. Labels: "TOP: FAST AND LOUD" at the top of the left panel, "BOTTOM: SLOW AND QUIET" at the top of the right panel, "VOLUME" beside the turnstile counter.

key: A crowd pushing a car up a hill
name: ch05_fewer_pushers_car_rolls
alt: Three pushes of a stalled car up a hill with fewer helpers each time, ending with the car rolling back down as people jump aside.
scene: A wide side view of a steep village road climbing from left to right through the Western Ghats, with tea bushes and a small temple on the hillside. A stalled old white boxy sedan is shown three times along the slope like a time-lapse. FIRST push, lower left: a big group of eight villagers, farmers in banians and dhotis, a schoolboy, a woman with her pallu tucked in, all shoving the car's back with energetic faces and sweat drops. SECOND push, higher up the slope: the car is higher but only four people push, looking more tired. THIRD push, near the crest: just two exhausted people lean on the bumper, faces strained, and the car stops short of the second position's height. To the far right, beyond the third push, the car is drawn rolling backward downhill with motion lines while several people leap out of its path, arms flailing, small sound marks of shouting. The driver in a cap hangs out the window, alarmed. Below the road, a small row of figure icons shrinks from eight to four to two. Hazy monsoon afternoon light, green and terracotta tones, comic but tense mood. Labels: "LEFT SHOULDER" above the first push, "HEAD" above the second, "RIGHT SHOULDER" above the third.

key: A weather forecast says rain
name: ch05_forecast_rain_sun_returns
alt: A man waits with an open umbrella after a rain forecast while the clouds part and the sun comes out, and a friend tells him to put it away.
scene: A street-level view of a residential lane in Pune with low houses, a neem tree and a tea stall. In the centre a man in his 40s wearing a short-sleeved shirt, trousers and sandals stands stubbornly with a big black umbrella open over his head, phone in his other hand showing a rain-cloud icon, his face stubborn and sweating. Above him the dark clouds of a moment earlier are breaking apart, and bright sunlight streams through the gap onto him; a few last raindrops are still falling on the left edge of the frame, but the right side is fully sunny with a dry road. On the right a friend at the tea stall, a cheerful woman in a cotton salwar with a cup of chai, points up at the sun and waves at him to fold the umbrella. On the ground in front of the man, a thin chalk line is drawn across the road; earlier small wet footprints went below it, but his current footprints step back above it. A small inset bubble at the top left shows the original forecast card with a rain cloud and a downward arrow, now with a light cross over it. Bright warm sunlight against clearing grey, slightly humorous mood. Labels: "FAILED PATTERN" above the man, "BACK ABOVE THE NECKLINE" along the chalk line.

key: A saucer is a supertanker turning
name: ch05_supertanker_vs_car_wall
alt: A huge tanker slowly turning in a wide arc across the sea, contrasted with a car that suddenly bounces back after hitting a wall.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line. LEFT panel: a high aerial view of the Arabian Sea near a port, a massive red-and-black supertanker drawn turning in a very wide, smooth U-shaped arc, its long white wake curving gently across the whole panel; tiny tugboats and a fishing boat look minuscule beside it. On the deck, a captain in white uniform stands with a cup of tea, perfectly calm. A dotted gentle curve traces the bowl-shaped path. RIGHT panel: a ground-level view of a test track, a small blue hatchback car slamming nose-first into a padded concrete barrier, a burst of impact lines and flying foam, and a sharp V-shaped arrow showing the car bouncing straight back the way it came. A crash-test dummy inside lurches forward, and a technician in overalls behind a yellow line covers his ears. The left panel feels slow and spacious with lots of open water; the right feels sudden and cramped. Labels: "SAUCER BOTTOM" at the top of the left panel along the curve, "SPIKE V-REVERSAL" at the top of the right panel above the V arrow. Calm blue morning light on the left, harsh white daylight with a dramatic impact on the right.

key: runner stopping at a water table
name: ch06_marathon_water_stop
alt: A marathon runner pauses briefly at a roadside water table and keeps facing forward, while in an inset another runner sits down, removes his shoes and walks back.
scene: A wide street-level view of a city marathon route along a seafront promenade like Marine Drive, the road running from left to right with runners in coloured vests heading right. In the centre, a lean woman runner in her 30s with a bib number, cap and sweatband pauses at a folding table staffed by two smiling volunteers in matching orange t-shirts; she grabs a paper cup, tips her head back to drink, but her body, feet and gaze still point to the right, one foot already lifted to go. Spilled cups and orange peels litter the ground. A short dotted arc above her shows the pause, followed by a solid arrow continuing to the right. In a circular inset bubble at the top right, a different runner, a middle-aged man in a blue vest, sits on the kerb, has pulled off one shoe, socks drooping, and is walking back the way he came with the shoe in his hand, a U-turn arrow beside him. Spectators with banners and a drummer cheer from the sea wall behind. Bright early-morning sun, sea sparkling, energetic and purposeful mood. Labels: "CONTINUATION" above the drinking runner, "REVERSAL" inside the inset bubble.

key: A queue of buyers outside a shop whose
name: ch06_queue_at_fixed_price_shop
alt: Customers queue each morning ever closer to a shop door where the owner sells at a fixed price, until his stock runs out and the price board has to be raised.
scene: A frontal view of a small mithai and dry-fruit shop in an old Delhi lane, with a glass counter, a wooden shelf of tins and a chalk price board on the wall reading "90". Behind the counter stands a stubborn shopkeeper in his 60s with a white kurta, a Gandhi-style cap and a firm, folded-arm stance. His stock shelf behind him is shown in three stacked strip-images above the shop like a calendar, each day with fewer tins left. In front of the shop, the queue of buyers, office workers, a grandmother with a cloth bag, a delivery boy, college students, is drawn as overlapping ghosted lines from different mornings, each morning's queue starting a little closer to the door and higher up the shop steps, forming a rising diagonal. A flat horizontal rope barrier hangs across the doorway at the height of the price board. On the far right, the last tin is gone and the shopkeeper is wiping out 90 and writing 91 on the board while the front buyer leans in eagerly. Warm morning light filtering through the lane, crowded and expectant mood. Labels: "FLAT RESISTANCE" along the rope at the doorway, "RISING LOWS" beside the stepped queue, "BREAKOUT" next to the board being rewritten.

key: A flag on a pole, hoisted halfway up
name: ch06_flag_halfway_up_pole
alt: A flag hung halfway up a tall flagpole on a school ground, with the pole below it and the equal empty length of pole above it marked as the expected move.
scene: A low-angle view of a tall white flagpole in the centre of a government school ground on a clear morning, the school building with blue shutters behind and a row of students in white and navy uniforms standing in assembly lines at the base. A rectangular saffron-coloured cloth flag, plain with no emblem, flutters exactly halfway up the pole, caught mid-hoist on its rope. A school peon in his 50s in khaki holds the rope at the bottom, looking up and shading his eyes. Along the left side of the pole a thick bracket spans the lower half from the ground to the flag, and on the right side an identical dashed bracket spans the empty upper half from the flag to the gold finial at the top, with a small equal sign between the two brackets. A thin upward arrow runs along the empty top half. Two small children at the front of the line point up at the top of the pole curiously. Crisp blue sky with a few clouds, long morning shadows across the dusty ground, hopeful and orderly mood. Labels: "THE MOVE SO FAR" beside the lower bracket, "FLAG" beside the cloth, "SAME DISTANCE AGAIN" beside the upper dashed bracket.

key: slips once, badly, in the middle
name: ch06_tug_of_war_slip_recover
alt: A winning tug-of-war team slips badly once in the middle of the contest, between two smaller slips, then digs in and pulls harder.
scene: A wide side view of a tug-of-war contest at a college sports day on a grassy field, the thick rope running from left to right with a red ribbon tied at its centre above a chalk line. The winning team on the right, six young men in matching green t-shirts and shorts, is shown in three overlapping ghosted moments: first a small stumble where they lean back slightly off balance; then, in the middle, a big dramatic slip where the front puller falls onto one knee, mud splashing, and the whole line lurches toward the centre; then a second small stumble of the same size as the first. In the final solid foreground pose, they dig their heels into the turf, leaning far back with gritted teeth, pulling the ribbon well over to their side. The opposing team on the left, in yellow, strains but loses ground. A teacher with a whistle and a clipboard stands at the centre line. Along the bottom, a small strip shows three dips in a line, small, big, small, with the ribbon then moving decisively right. Bright noon sun, green field, energetic and determined mood. Labels: "SHOULDER" under each small slip, "HEAD" under the big slip, "TREND RESUMES" above the final pull.

key: The rev counter (volume) shows how hard
name: ch07_car_dashboard_three_gauges
alt: A close-up of a car dashboard where the speedometer, rev counter and fuel gauge each stand for price, volume and open interest.
scene: A driver's-eye close-up of a car dashboard at night on an Indian expressway, the windscreen showing tail lights and reflective road markers stretching ahead into darkness. Three large round analog gauges dominate the frame from left to right, softly backlit in white and amber. On the left, the speedometer needle points steadily to 100. In the middle, the rev counter needle sits deep in the red zone with a small warning glow, the engine visibly straining. On the right, the fuel gauge needle rests just above empty with a small fuel-pump warning light lit. The driver's hands, a man with a steel kada bracelet on his wrist, grip the steering wheel at the bottom of the frame. In a small inset bubble at the top right, the healthy comparison: the same speedometer at 100, the rev counter calm in the middle, and the fuel gauge full. Thin leader lines connect each gauge to its label. A highway sign in the distance reads "EXIT" only. Dark blue night tones with glowing amber and red highlights, focused and slightly tense mood. Labels: "PRICE" above the speedometer, "VOLUME" above the rev counter, "OPEN INTEREST" above the fuel gauge.

key: A dance floor where everyone must dance
name: ch07_dance_couples_open_interest
alt: A wedding dance floor where every dancer must be in a pair, with a counter tallying couples rather than people and a second tally counting partner changes.
scene: A lively overhead three-quarter view of a sangeet night dance floor at an Indian wedding, a polished floor ringed by marigold garlands and fairy lights, a DJ booth at the back. On the floor dance six couples, each made up of one person wearing a green dupatta or sash and one wearing an orange sash, holding hands and twirling: a young couple in lehenga and sherwani, two aunties in silk sarees, two uncles in kurtas laughing, cousins in jeans and kurtis. A thin glowing ring is drawn around each couple to show the pair as one unit. At the left edge, an elderly relative in a shawl sits at a small table with a clicker counter, carefully counting the rings, the counter showing the number 6. At the right edge, a teenage cousin with a notebook keeps a separate tally of hand-offs: dotted arrows show one dancer leaving a couple and another stepping in to take the hand, and each hand-off gets a stroke in her notebook. Warm golden and pink lighting with confetti in the air, joyful and busy mood. Labels: "OPEN INTEREST = COUPLES" beside the elderly counter, "VOLUME = HAND-OFFS" beside the teenage cousin, "LONG + SHORT" next to one highlighted couple.

key: A concert sells out and the box office
name: ch07_sold_out_box_office
alt: A box office with its shutter down and a sold-out sign, an idle ticket clerk with a nearly empty sales book, and a huge crowd still waiting outside.
scene: A wide evening view outside a concert auditorium in an Indian city. In the centre, the small box-office window has its metal shutter pulled down, a paper sign taped on it reading "SOLD OUT". Inside, visible through a side window, a bored clerk in his 30s with a lanyard leans back in his chair scrolling his phone, a ledger on the desk beside him open on a page with only two short ticket entries. Outside, a huge crowd fills the whole foreground and stretches far down the street to the left: students in band t-shirts, couples, a group of friends with face paint, an uncle holding money in the air, people standing on bollards to see, all pressing toward the closed shutter with eager, frustrated faces. A long curved arrow traces the crowd's length to show how big the hidden demand is, while a thin small arrow from the ledger points to a tiny number. Street lights and the glowing auditorium marquee, purple and orange evening tones, packed and impatient mood. Labels: "LOCKED LIMIT" on the shutter, "LOW VOLUME" beside the ledger, "REAL DEMAND" above the waiting crowd.

key: A blowoff is the last guests rushing
name: ch07_blowoff_and_stampede
alt: Two scenes of a party house: latecomers rushing in the front while earlier guests slip out the back, and a stampede where everyone leaves at once leaving the hall empty.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing a cut-away view of the same bungalow with a front door on the left and a back door on the right. LEFT panel: a rush of excited latecomers in party clothes, a man in a shiny jacket, two women with gift boxes, piles through the front door with motion lines, while out of the back door a quiet line of earlier guests, tired and holding their shoes or empty plates, slips away unnoticed into the dark garden; a small counter by the back door ticks down. A tall upward spike arrow is drawn above the roof. RIGHT panel: a stampede for the exit, every guest pouring out of both doors at once in a single burst, a woman holding her saree hem, a man clutching his phone, a kid on a parent's shoulders, chairs knocked over inside; just beyond them, the inside of the house is now completely empty with streamers hanging. A sharp downward spike arrow is drawn above that roof. Night lighting with warm interior glow, party colours on the left and cooler panicky tones on the right. Labels: "BLOWOFF" at the top of the left panel, "FALLING OPEN INTEREST" beside the back door, "SELLING CLIMAX" at the top of the right panel.

key: A coastline looks jagged from a cliff
name: ch08_coastline_three_heights
alt: The same jagged rocky coastline seen from a cliff, from a plane and from a satellite, each view showing bays and headlands of a similar shape at different scales.
scene: A three-tier vertical composition showing one stretch of the Konkan coast at three heights, stacked from bottom to top, each tier framed as a rounded rectangle. BOTTOM tier: a ground-level view from a laterite cliff, a hiker in his 20s with a cap and backpack standing at the edge looking down at small rocky coves, waves foaming, a fishing hut and coconut palms. MIDDLE tier: the view from an aeroplane window, the curved window frame visible, a passenger's hand on the sill, showing a longer coastline with bigger bays and headlands of the same jagged rhythm. TOP tier: a satellite view of the whole western coast, the bays now huge, a tiny satellite drawn at the top corner with its solar panels. In each tier one bay and one headland are outlined with the same thin orange contour, and the three outlines have the same zig-zag shape at different sizes, linked by dashed lines running up the side of the stack. A small scale bar on each tier reads "1 KM", "50 KM" and "500 KM". Clear sunny day, turquoise water and red-brown cliffs, curious and expansive mood. Labels: "DAILY" beside the bottom tier, "WEEKLY" beside the middle tier, "MONTHLY" beside the top tier.

key: A relay race filmed by following
name: ch08_relay_baton_camera_jump
alt: A relay race filmed by a camera that follows the baton, so the shot jumps from one runner to the next at each hand-off even though no runner actually moved.
scene: A side view of a relay race on a red running track in a stadium, runners heading from left to right. In the middle of the frame two runners at a hand-off: the incoming runner, a young woman in a white and blue vest, stretches her arm forward with the baton, and the outgoing runner, slightly ahead in the next lane zone, reaches back with an open palm. Above them, a camera operator on a small motorised dolly rail running parallel to the track holds a TV camera pointed at the baton, a dotted frame showing what the camera sees. On a large stadium screen in the top right corner, the broadcast shot shows only one runner in frame who seems to suddenly jump forward by a few metres, with a glitch line across the screen. A pair of tiny dotted footprint trails on the track shows that both real runners are just running steadily in their own places. A coach in a tracksuit by the infield shrugs at the screen. Bright afternoon sun, crowd in stands behind, crisp and slightly playful mood. Labels: "OLD CONTRACT" above the incoming runner, "NEW CONTRACT" above the outgoing runner, "ROLLOVER GAP" beside the glitch on the stadium screen.

key: A ruler that shrinks a little every year
name: ch08_shrinking_ruler_inflation
alt: A carpenter measures the same table with an old long ruler and a newer shorter ruler, so the table reads longer today, while customers place orders using today's ruler.
scene: A warm interior of a small carpentry workshop in an Indian town, sawdust on the floor, tools on a pegboard wall, a half-finished wooden table in the centre. An old carpenter in his 60s with a white beard, round glasses and a sleeveless vest kneels by the table holding two wooden rulers side by side against its edge. The upper ruler is old, faded and longer, with widely spaced markings, a small tag tied to it showing an old calendar year. The lower ruler is newer, brighter and visibly shorter, with tighter markings, so the table edge reaches a larger number on it; a thin dashed line shows the table end hitting different numbers on each. Behind him, at a counter with a ledger, his young grandson in a t-shirt takes an order from a customer in a sari who points at the newer ruler, the price slip in her hand marked with that ruler's number. A small inset bubble above shows a stack of shrinking rulers, each slightly shorter than the last, fading leftward into the past. Golden afternoon light through a dusty window, nostalgic and thoughtful mood. Labels: "INFLATION" beside the shrinking ruler stack, "QUOTED PRICE" pointing to the newer ruler the customer uses.

key: A path worn across a lawn
name: ch08_worn_path_across_lawn
alt: An aerial photo of a park lawn with a diagonal path worn bare by people walking the same route, with a few walkers still following it.
scene: A high aerial view of a large green public park in an Indian city, like a maidan, with neat paved walkways around its rectangular edges and a fountain in one corner. Cutting diagonally across the lush grass from a bus stop at the bottom left to a temple gate at the top right is a clearly worn brown footpath, bare earth showing where countless feet have walked, the grass flattened and thin along it. On the path, small figures follow it: a man in office wear with a briefcase, two schoolchildren with heavy bags, a woman with a vegetable basket on her head, an old man with a walking stick, all stepping exactly on the worn strip, ignoring the paved walkway. A faded wooden sign near the corner says "KEEP OFF GRASS" and nobody pays attention. In a small inset bubble at the bottom right, a close-up shows a pile of old footprints at one point on the path, layered with newer ones on top. A camera icon with a dashed viewing cone is drawn at the top edge to show this is an aerial snapshot. Soft late-afternoon light with long tree shadows, quiet and observational mood. Labels: "OLD PRICE LEVEL" along the worn path, "MONTHLY CHART" beside the camera icon.

key: Price is a dog on a lead, running
name: ch09_dog_on_lead_owner_line
alt: An excited dog on a long lead zig-zags left and right across a park path while its owner walks steadily behind, showing the real direction of the walk.
scene: A slightly elevated three-quarter view of a winding path through a city park in the early morning, trees and benches on both sides, walkers in the distance. In the foreground, an excited brown Indian pariah dog with a red collar zig-zags wildly at the end of a long lead: sniffing a lamppost on the left, then darting right after a pigeon, then nosing at a dropped samosa wrapper. Its erratic route is drawn as a busy, looping dotted line. Behind it, holding the other end of the lead, walks the owner, a calm man in his 50s in a white kurta-pyjama and sports shoes, hands relaxed, walking in a smooth straight line along the path; his own route is drawn as a single gentle, steady solid line that runs through the middle of the dog's loops and points up the path. A morning walker group of three aunties in sarees with sports shoes overtakes on the side, smiling. Small paw prints and footprints on the path reinforce the two different routes. Soft golden morning light, mist between trees, peaceful mood. Labels: "PRICE" beside the dog's dotted zig-zag, "MOVING AVERAGE" beside the owner's smooth line.

key: A short MA is a nervous guard dog
name: ch09_nervous_vs_sleepy_guard_dog
alt: Two guard dogs at a house gate: a small jumpy dog barking at a falling leaf and a big sleepy dog only waking as a burglar is already inside.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing the same bungalow gate at night with a street lamp and a bougainvillea bush. LEFT panel: a small, wiry white terrier-like dog stands rigid at the gate barking furiously, ears up, with jagged sound marks, at a single dry leaf drifting down from a tree; in the background a silhouetted thief in a dark cap is only just approaching the far corner of the street, and a second small inset bark mark shows the dog already alert to him too. The owner, a sleepy woman in a nightgown, peers out of a window, annoyed. RIGHT panel: a big heavy brown dog lies flat asleep on a jute mat by the gate, snoring with little Z marks, leaves falling on its back unnoticed; behind it, through an open window, a burglar in a striped shirt is already inside the house carrying a television, and only now does the dog open one eye in alarm. Moonlight and the orange street lamp light both panels, dark blues and warm yellows, comic mood. Labels: "SHORT MA: EARLY BUT JUMPY" at the top of the left panel, "LONG MA: CALM BUT LATE" at the top of the right panel.

key: Three cars leaving a junction
name: ch09_scooter_car_bus_junction
alt: At a busy junction, a nimble scooter turns first, then a car, then a large bus, showing a fast, medium and slow moving average turning in sequence.
scene: A high-angle view of a busy Bengaluru traffic junction with a painted roundabout and zebra crossing, a traffic policeman in a white shirt and khaki trousers on a raised podium in the centre, his arm signalling a right turn. The road branches upward to the right. Three vehicles are in the act of turning onto it: in front, a nimble red scooter ridden by a young woman in a helmet and kurta has already completed the turn, zipping ahead with motion lines; behind her, a white hatchback car driven by a man in a cap is midway through the turn; at the back, a big blue city bus packed with commuters is only just beginning to swing its long body round, its front wheels angled. Curved arrows show each vehicle's path, the scooter's tight and early, the car's medium, the bus's wide and late. A coloured strip running along the bottom edge shifts from grey on the left where the three are pointing different ways to green on the right where all three point up the new road. Warm late-afternoon light with dust in the air and honking marks, busy but orderly mood. Labels: "4-DAY" above the scooter, "9-DAY" above the car, "18-DAY" above the bus.

key: In waves (trends) the board flies
name: ch09_surfer_waves_vs_flat_sea
alt: A surfer flies across a big rolling wave, while in a second panel the same surfer paddles tiredly in circles on a flat calm sea.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves set off a sandy Indian beach like the Mulki coast near Mangalore, with palm trees on the shore. LEFT panel: a big green-blue wave curls from left to right, and a surfer in her 20s in a black rash vest and board shorts rides its face, crouched low, arms out, grinning, spray flying behind the board; a long smooth arrow follows her path down the wave, and a small coin icon with a plus sign floats above her. RIGHT panel: the same surfer sits on her board on a perfectly flat glassy sea, paddling in small circles with drooping shoulders and a tired, bored face; a looping circular dotted line traces her aimless path, small sweat drops on her brow, and a small coin icon with a minus sign floats above her, several coins slipping into the water. A pair of seagulls watch her lazily from the flat water. Bright midday sun, turquoise water on the left with white foam, pale flat grey-blue on the right, energetic versus listless mood. Labels: "TRENDING MARKET" at the top of the left panel, "SIDEWAYS MARKET" at the top of the right panel, "CROSSOVER WHIPSAW" beside the looping path.

key: Throw a ball straight up. Its speed
name: ch10_ball_thrown_up_speed
alt: A boy throws a cricket ball straight up; speed arrows beside the ball shrink as it rises, reaching zero at the top, showing momentum fading before the price peak.
scene: A tall vertical composition on a dusty gully-cricket lane between apartment blocks in an Indian city, washing lines and a mango tree in the background. At the bottom centre, a boy of about twelve in a faded cricket jersey and shorts has just flung a red tennis ball straight up with his right hand, his arm fully extended, head tilted back, mouth open in excitement; two friends with a plank bat and a plastic stump look up too. The ball is drawn at five positions climbing straight up the frame like a time-lapse, each copy a little more transparent. Beside each copy is a horizontal speed arrow: very long at the bottom, then shorter, shorter, very short, and at the topmost ball just a small dot with the number 0. A thin dotted line connects the tips of the speed arrows, curving down well before the ball reaches the top, while the ball's height keeps rising. On the right edge, a small vertical gauge like a thermometer shows the speed level dropping from full to empty. Bright afternoon sun, long shadows, playful but instructive mood. Labels: "PRICE" beside the column of balls, "MOMENTUM" beside the shrinking speed arrows, "ZERO AT THE TOP" next to the highest ball.

key: Catching a falling knife versus picking
name: ch10_falling_knife_wait_to_land
alt: In a kitchen one cook grabs at a knife still falling through the air while another waits and picks it up calmly after it has landed on the floor.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing the same busy home kitchen with steel utensils on a rack, a gas stove with a pressure cooker and a tiled floor. LEFT panel: a young man in his 20s in a t-shirt and shorts lunges desperately with an outstretched hand toward a large sharp steel kitchen knife that is tumbling through the air in mid-fall, motion arcs showing it spinning; his face is panicked, a small band-aid icon and a red warning flash drawn near his fingers, a bowl of chopped onions tipping over. RIGHT panel: the same knife now lies still on the tiled floor after landing, and an older woman in her 50s in a house saree with an apron calmly bends and picks it up by its handle with a composed, knowing smile; a small tick mark appears beside her hand. A thin dotted line in each panel traces the knife's path, ending mid-air on the left and on the floor on the right. Across the bottom of both panels runs a horizontal dashed line with the number 30 at its left end. Warm kitchen lighting, saturated colours, tense on the left and calm on the right. Labels: "BUY BELOW 30" at the top of the left panel, "BUY ON CROSS BACK ABOVE 30" at the top of the right panel.

key: chance to kick off and ride the current
name: ch10_swimmer_with_and_against_current
alt: A tired swimmer in a river rests in two situations: in a current flowing her way she kicks off and glides, and in a current against her she is pushed back.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing a wide brown river like the Ganga, with ghats and temple steps on the far bank and boats moored. Large flowing current arrows are drawn in the water. LEFT panel: the current arrows point to the right, and a swimmer in her 20s in a dark swimsuit and swim cap, having paused to float, now pushes off with a strong kick, gliding swiftly to the right with the current, her face relaxed and smiling, a small wake behind her. RIGHT panel: the current arrows point to the left against her, and the same swimmer, paused to float in the same pose, is being carried backward to the left, arms flailing, a grimace of effort, a small dotted line showing the distance she has lost. On the bank of each panel, an old boatman in a white vest and lungi sits on his wooden boat watching, nodding approvingly on the left and shaking his head on the right. Soft early-morning light with mist over the water, golden reflections, calm on the left and struggling on the right. Labels: "OVERSOLD IN AN UPTREND" at the top of the left panel, "OVERSOLD IN A DOWNTREND" at the top of the right panel, "TREND" beside the current arrows.

key: everyone has rushed to the same side
name: ch10_ferry_all_on_one_side
alt: Passengers on a ferry all crowd one side to watch a dolphin, tilting the boat, with nobody left to move that way and the boat about to tip back.
scene: A wide side view of a small wooden passenger ferry crossing a calm bay, like the Goa or Kochi ferries, with a striped canopy and a railing. Every passenger, office goers with bags, a family with children, two schoolgirls in uniform, an old man with a cloth bag, a vendor with a basket of peanuts, has rushed to the left railing and leans over pointing excitedly at a grey dolphin leaping out of the water. The whole boat tilts heavily to the left, water nearly reaching the lip, the canopy leaning, a basket slipping across the deck. The right side of the deck is completely empty except for a lone tilting plastic chair. A curved double-headed arrow is drawn above the boat showing the rocking motion, with the stronger head pointing back to the right. The ferry operator in a white vest at the rear tiller looks alarmed, waving one arm to signal people back. A small gauge drawn on the boat's side like a bubble level shows the bubble pinned at the extreme end. Bright sunny day, blue water and sky, comic but suspenseful mood. Labels: "EXTREME SENTIMENT" above the crowded left side, "NOBODY LEFT TO BUY" beside the empty right side, "CONTRARY OPINION" above the rocking arrow.

key: A point and figure chart is a diary
name: ch11_diary_only_writes_moves
alt: Two diaries side by side: one with a page for every day even when nothing happened, the other with entries only when something actually moved.
scene: A close top-down view of a wooden study desk with a brass lamp, a cup of chai and a pen stand. On the left lies a thick daily diary opened to show a fan of pages, every page dated, many of them with a single bored line such as a small flat dash, a doodle of a yawn, or a blank space, the stack of filler pages visibly fat. A hand belonging to a young woman in a cotton kurti, wearing a watch, rests on it. On the right lies a slim notebook open to a single page filled with neat columns of X and O symbols in grid squares, each column added only when something happened; small sticky tabs mark the busy days, one day's tab fat with several columns, while long quiet weeks between entries leave no mark at all. A thin arrow runs from a cluster of filler pages in the left diary across to the empty space between two columns on the right, showing those days simply vanish. A small calendar on the desk shows weeks with crossed-off days. Warm evening lamp light, wood and paper textures, quiet and studious mood. Labels: "BAR CHART: EVERY DAY" above the left diary, "POINT AND FIGURE: ONLY MOVES" above the right notebook.

key: Three maps of the same city
name: ch11_three_maps_same_city
alt: Three maps of the same city at different detail laid on a table, with a planner showing that the coarse map can be drawn from the detailed one but not the other way round.
scene: A slightly overhead view of a large drafting table in a town planning office in Chennai, a ceiling fan above, rolled blueprints in a corner. Laid out left to right are three paper maps of the same city. LEFT: a dense street map packed with lanes, gullies, a temple tank, a railway station and tiny houses. MIDDLE: a district map with only main roads and neighbourhood blocks shaded in pastel colours. RIGHT: a very simple map showing only the city as a blob with a river and one highway line. A planner in her 40s in a crisp cotton saree and spectacles stands behind the table, tracing with a pencil from the street map toward the district map along a solid arrow, and from the district map to the simple map along another solid arrow, a confident expression. A junior clerk in a short-sleeved shirt next to her holds a magnifying glass over the simple map trying to find street names, puzzled, with a small question mark above him and a dashed arrow pointing back from right to left that ends in a red stop mark. Soft afternoon light from tall windows, muted paper tones, thoughtful mood. Labels: "1-BOX" above the street map, "3-BOX" above the district map, "5-BOX" above the simple map.

key: A clerk with a fixed checklist
name: ch11_clerk_checklist_trend_first
alt: A government clerk with a printed checklist always asks first whether today extends the current column, only turning to the other question if the answer is no.
scene: A frontal medium shot of a counter in an old government office with green-painted walls, a wall clock, files tied with red tape stacked high, and a ceiling fan. Behind the counter sits a methodical clerk in his 50s with oiled hair, a thick moustache, half-rim glasses and a cream short-sleeved shirt with a pen in his pocket, stamping a form. Propped on a small stand in front of him is a laminated card with a two-step flowchart drawn on it: a first box with an up arrow and a question mark, a "YES" branch leading to an X being added on top of a column, and a "NO" branch leading down to a second smaller box with a down arrow and O symbols. His finger rests firmly on the first box. In front of the counter stands a young trader in a hoodie holding a sheet of paper showing a day's high and low, trying to point to the low first, while the clerk gently holds up his other palm to say not yet. Behind the young man, a queue waits patiently on a wooden bench. A sticky note on the clerk's monitor reads "RULE 1". Dim fluorescent light with dust motes, dry humour. Labels: "CURRENT TREND FIRST" above the clerk, "REVERSAL ONLY IF NO" beside the second flowchart box.

key: longer the spring was wound
name: ch11_wound_spring_and_first_jump
alt: A long coiled spring being wound tighter on the left flies far when released, and on the right a frog's first jump is measured to estimate its whole flight as three such jumps.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves set on a workbench in a small toy-repair shop in an Indian bazaar, with tin toys and wind-up cars on shelves behind. LEFT panel: an old toymaker in his 60s with a white beard, a cloth cap and a magnifier on a headband slowly turns the key of a large coiled spring mechanism inside a tin toy rocket; a row of tally marks beside it counts the turns, a long horizontal bracket spans the width of the tightly wound coil, and a long dotted arc arrow shows the rocket's expected flight, much longer for the longer bracket. RIGHT panel: a green tin wind-up frog has just made its first hop across the bench; a young apprentice in a t-shirt measures the first hop with a cloth tape, and a dashed arc projects two more hops of equal length ahead, making three hops in total, ending at a pencil mark on a ruler. Warm lamp light with metallic toy reflections, nostalgic and clever mood. Labels: "HORIZONTAL COUNT" at the top of the left panel above the coil bracket, "VERTICAL COUNT" at the top of the right panel, "3X THE FIRST JUMP" beside the projected hops.

key: Each day is a rope tug between buyers
name: ch12_rope_tug_candle_day
alt: A village tug-of-war on a vertical rope, with buyers pulling up and sellers pulling down, the rope's highest and lowest positions marked like shadows and its start and end like a body.
scene: A playful vertical composition at a village festival. A thick rope hangs vertically from a wooden pulley frame decorated with marigolds. At the top a team of three buyers in green kurtas stands on a raised wooden platform hauling the rope upward, and at the bottom a team of three sellers in red kurtas plants their feet in the dirt hauling it downward. A bright knot of ribbon is tied on the rope, and its journey through the day is drawn on a tall wooden scale board beside the rope: a faint ghosted ribbon at the highest point it was dragged to, another ghosted ribbon at the lowest, and a thicker bar painted on the board between where the ribbon started in the morning and where it ended at sunset. A village elder in a white dhoti and turban sits on a cot beside the board as referee, holding a small bell, chalking marks on the scale. A sun low in the sky on one side and a rising sun icon on the other indicate the start and end of the day. Children cheer around the frame. Warm festive light, saturated greens and reds, energetic mood. Labels: "SHADOW" pointing to the thin span reaching the highest and lowest ghosted ribbons, "REAL BODY" pointing to the thick bar between start and end.

key: A party is in full swing (long white
name: ch12_party_dark_cloud_exit
alt: A wedding reception in full swing at night, more guests arriving early next morning, and through the day the hall emptying below its midnight crowd as late arrivals head for the exit.
scene: A three-panel horizontal strip showing the same decorated wedding reception hall with a stage, floral backdrop and round tables. LEFT panel, night: the party in full swing, the hall packed, a band playing, people dancing joyfully, glowing fairy lights, a big rising arrow. MIDDLE panel, early next morning: even more guests arriving through the entrance, a fresh group in bright clothes with gifts squeezing in, the crowd level now visibly higher than the night before, shown by a horizontal dashed line marking last night's peak which the new crowd exceeds. RIGHT panel, late afternoon: guests quietly streaming out of the exit door, carrying return gifts, many of them the morning arrivals looking glum and checking their watches; the crowd inside has thinned to well below a second dashed line drawn at half of last night's crowd. A downward arrow follows the leaving guests. A caterer in a white uniform stacks plates in the corner, unimpressed. Lighting shifts from golden night lights to bright morning to dull afternoon grey. Labels: "LONG WHITE DAY" at the top of the left panel, "GAP UP OPEN" at the top of the middle panel, "DARK CLOUD COVER" at the top of the right panel.

key: a small star appears above the horizon
name: ch12_evening_star_sunset
alt: A three-stage sunset over the sea: the sun high, a small bright star alone above the horizon, then darkness falling, showing the evening star pattern.
scene: A wide horizontal triptych of the same seafront horizon, viewed from a quiet beach promenade in Puducherry with a low stone wall and an old lamp post in the foreground of each panel. LEFT panel: the late-afternoon sun is large and high, the sky bright warm orange-gold, a couple strolling on the promenade with ice creams, a tall golden column of light reflected on the water. MIDDLE panel: the sun has gone, and a single small bright star sits just above the horizon line, slightly separated from where the sun was, with a tiny gap of empty sky between them; the sky is a still twilight purple and the couple have paused to look at it, the man pointing. RIGHT panel: deep night, a long dark navy band across the sky pushing down below the middle of where the sun once shone, the couple walking away with a torch, the lamp post now lit. Across all three panels a thin dotted line connects the sun, the star and the dark band. Rich gradient colours from gold to violet to navy, calm and slightly ominous mood. Labels: "DAY 1" above the left panel, "STAR" beside the small star, "DAY 3" above the right panel.

key: A hiker climbs hard (day 1), sits on a
name: ch12_hiker_rests_on_ledge
alt: A hiker climbs a steep rock face, rests on a ledge for a few minutes shuffling back slightly, then climbs past the previous high point.
scene: A side view of a steep rocky hillside in the Sahyadri ranges with a narrow trail and patches of green grass, monsoon mist below. A hiker in his 20s in a quick-dry orange t-shirt, cargo shorts, trekking shoes and a small backpack is shown in a time-lapse sequence of ghosted poses. First he scrambles hard up a long steep section, a long upward bar painted on the rock wall beside him marking this climb from its base to its top. Next he sits on a narrow ledge partway down from his high point, drinking from a steel water bottle, then shuffles back a little on the ledge in two smaller poses, all of them staying within the vertical span of that long painted bar. Finally he stands up and climbs on past the top of the bar to a higher outcrop, arms raised triumphantly. Small dotted lines trace his path. A tiny flag on the outcrop flutters. A curious langur monkey watches from a rock. Cool morning light with mist, greens and browns, steady and determined mood. Labels: "DAY 1" beside the long painted bar, "REST DAYS INSIDE THE BODY" beside the ledge, "DAY 5 BREAKS HIGHER" near the outcrop.

key: Climbing a staircase with two landings
name: ch13_staircase_five_up_three_down
alt: A climber goes up a temple staircase in five moves with two landings, then comes down in three moves: down, a hopeful bounce, and down again.
scene: A wide side cross-section of a hillside temple staircase like the steps at Chamundi hill, carved stone steps rising from left to right with a small shrine at the top and trees on either side. A pilgrim in his 30s in a white dhoti, a saffron shawl and bare feet climbs, shown in ghosted time-lapse poses along a dotted path: a first short climb, a short slip back down a few steps to a landing, a long energetic climb up the biggest flight, another rest on a second landing where he slips back a little, and a final push to the top where he rings the temple bell. Then on the right, the descent: he walks down a flight, turns and climbs back up a few steps hopefully as if he forgot something, then walks down again, further. Small numbered stone markers sit beside each move. A flower seller sits on one landing with a basket of jasmine. A monkey sits on the parapet watching. Warm late-morning sun, stone grey and saffron tones, devotional and rhythmic mood. Labels: "1 2 3 4 5" written on the stone markers along the climb, "A B C" written on the markers along the descent, "IMPULSE THEN CORRECTION" across the top of the frame.

key: A coastline seen from a plane
name: ch13_coastline_fractal_zoom
alt: The same jagged coastline seen from a plane, from a boat and on foot, each zoom revealing the same five-and-three zig-zag shape at a smaller size.
scene: A composition of three nested circular magnifying lenses over one stretch of rugged coastline near Gokarna, with red laterite cliffs, small beaches and turquoise water. In the background, filling the frame, is the view from an aeroplane, the plane's wingtip visible at top left, the coastline forming a large zig-zag with five up-strokes and three down-strokes, traced with a thin orange line. A first circular lens zooms in on one of the large strokes as seen from a fishing boat, a fisherman in a lungi and a towel on his head pulling a net, and inside that lens the same section breaks into its own smaller five-and-three zig-zag, traced in the same orange. A second, smaller lens zooms further onto a single beach seen on foot, a woman in a sun hat walking barefoot along the wet sand, and the shoreline there again shows the same zig-zag at a tiny scale. Thin connector lines join each lens to the spot it magnifies. Bright clear day, turquoise, red-brown and green palette, curious and wondrous mood. Labels: "CYCLE" beside the large aerial zig-zag, "WAVE" beside the boat lens, "SUB-WAVE" beside the walking lens.

key: A football team that got burned
name: ch13_football_team_learns_trick
alt: A football defence that was fooled by a quick trick in the last match now blocks it, so the attackers switch to a slow, tangled build-up that tires the defence out.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing a dusty local football ground in Kolkata with a goal post, a crowd on a low wall and a banyan tree. LEFT panel, last match: a striker in a yellow jersey performs a sharp quick one-two pass and races straight through a surprised defence in blue jerseys, defenders caught flat-footed with startled faces, a fast straight arrow running to the goal and the ball in the net. RIGHT panel, this match: the same blue defenders are now ready, crouched and lined up early to block that exact quick path, one even pointing at it knowingly; but the yellow team instead passes slowly and sideways in a long tangled pattern, a looping messy dotted path that goes back and forth across the pitch, and the blue defenders are drawn panting, hands on knees, sweating and exhausted. A coach on the sideline in a tracksuit taps his temple with a smile. Afternoon sun with long shadows, red dust, competitive mood. Labels: "SHARP CORRECTION" at the top of the left panel, "FLAT SIDEWAYS CORRECTION" at the top of the right panel, "ALTERNATION" centred along the bottom.

key: The ratios are a set of rulers
name: ch13_fibonacci_rulers_cluster
alt: A tailor lays several measuring rulers of different lengths from different starting points on a length of cloth, and where several ruler ends land close together he marks the target.
scene: A top-down view of a wide wooden tailoring table in a small tailor shop in Jaipur, with spools of thread, scissors, a sewing machine at one corner and a bright bandhani fabric roll spread across the table. A master tailor in his 50s with a measuring tape round his neck, a pencil behind his ear and a crisp white kurta leans over the table. He has laid four slim wooden rulers on the fabric, each starting from a different chalk mark along the left edge and each a different length, labelled on their handles with small numbers like 1.618, 1.0, 0.618 and 2.618. Their far ends land close together in one small zone near the right edge of the fabric, and he has drawn a chalk circle around that cluster with a confident flourish. A first short ruler at the bottom, measuring the very first section of the cloth, is shaded to show it is the reference. A young assistant beside him holds a lamp closer, impressed. Warm workshop light, colourful fabric patterns, precise and crafty mood. Labels: "WAVE 1" beside the reference ruler, "FIBONACCI RATIOS" beside the ruler handles, "TARGET ZONE" beside the chalk circle.

key: Amplitude is how high it goes
name: ch14_park_swing_three_measures
alt: A child on a park swing with its height, the duration of one full swing and its current position marked, explaining amplitude, period and phase.
scene: A side view of a single swing on a red metal frame in a neighbourhood park in Hyderabad, neem trees and a slide behind. A girl of about seven in a yellow frock and two pigtails swings forward, legs stretched out, laughing. Her full arc is drawn as a ghosted pendulum path with three faded copies of her: one at the far back high point, one at the lowest point near the ground, and one at the far front high point. A vertical double-headed arrow on the right spans from the lowest point of the arc to the highest point. A curved arrow along the arc goes all the way out and back, with a small stopwatch icon at its start. A bright pin-like marker sits at her current position, about a quarter of the way up the forward swing, with a small clock-hand dial showing where in the cycle she is. Her father, a man in his 30s in a polo shirt and jeans, stands to the side holding a phone and watching with a gentle smile, and a younger brother waits his turn holding an ice lolly. Bright late-afternoon light filtering through leaves, cheerful mood. Labels: "AMPLITUDE" beside the vertical arrow, "PERIOD" beside the stopwatch and full-swing arrow, "PHASE" beside the current-position marker.

key: Several children on swings of different
name: ch14_swings_on_one_rope
alt: Several children on swings of different lengths, all tied to one long rope whose height at each moment is the sum of their motions, forming two humps.
scene: A wide side view of a long wooden swing frame in a village school playground, with five swings hanging from it on chains of very different lengths, from very long to very short, arranged left to right. On each swing sits a child in a school uniform of white shirt and navy shorts or skirt, each at a different point in their swing: the child on the longest swing at the top of a slow wide arc, the child on the shortest swing dipping quickly at the bottom. A single bright red rope runs along beneath all the swing seats, loosely tied to each one, so it bends up and down with them; the rope forms two humps with a small dip in between. A thin bracket marks the two humps. A teacher in a cotton saree stands at the far left holding the rope's end and looking amused, while a group of children on the ground point at the wavy rope. A small inset at the top right shows simple wave lines of different lengths being added together into one wavy line. Sunny morning, dusty ground, cheerful and playful mood. Labels: "LONG CYCLE" above the longest swing, "SHORT CYCLE" above the shortest swing, "PRICE = SUM OF CYCLES" along the red rope.

key: A boat on a wave on a tide
name: ch14_boat_wave_tide_channel
alt: A fishing boat bobs on waves riding on a rising tide, and seen from the shore its bounces stay between two parallel lines like a channel.
scene: A wide view from a sandy shore at a fishing harbour in Kerala, coconut palms and Chinese-style fishing nets on the left. In the middle distance a small colourful wooden fishing boat with an outboard motor and a fisherman in a checked lungi and towel headband bobs on the water. The scene is drawn as a time-lapse: the boat appears five times from left to right, alternately lifted on a wave crest and dipped in a trough, while the overall waterline slopes gently upward from left to right showing the rising tide. Two thin parallel dashed lines, one along the crests and one along the troughs, frame the boat's bounces and both slope upward together. A third faint, slower swell is drawn beneath, making the middle bounce taller than the two either side of it. On the shore in the foreground, an old fisherwoman in a sari sits mending a net, watching, and a boy points at the boat. A tide-level pole stands in the water with markings rising. Warm early-evening light, teal water and coral sky, rhythmic and peaceful mood. Labels: "TIDE" beside the rising waterline, "WAVES" beside the bouncing boat, "CHANNEL" along the parallel dashed lines.

key: Going up, you reach the top of each
name: ch14_escalator_crest_shift
alt: A person walks up an up-escalator and reaches each high point later, while another walks on a down-escalator and each rise is cut short early.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing a metro station escalator in a modern Indian city, steel side panels and a tiled wall with a station map. LEFT panel: an up-escalator rising to the right; a young man in a backpack and t-shirt walks briskly up it while the escalator carries him, his path drawn as a wavy dotted line whose bumps lean forward to the right, each crest arriving later than the middle of its bump, with a small arrow marking the shifted crest. An inset clock badge shows the time a little late. RIGHT panel: a down-escalator descending to the right; a woman in a salwar suit with a handbag tries to walk up it in short bursts, her path drawn as a wavy dotted line sloping down, each bump short and leaning back to the left, the crest coming early and the fall long. A small clock badge shows the time a little early. A cleaner with a mop and commuters with phones are in the background. Bright station lighting, steel greys with blue and green accents, clear and diagrammatic mood. Labels: "RIGHT TRANSLATION" at the top of the left panel, "LEFT TRANSLATION" at the top of the right panel.

key: A calculator in an exam. If you
name: ch15_exam_calculator_two_students
alt: Two students in an exam hall with calculators: one who understands the problem finishes quickly, while the other confidently writes a long precise but wrong answer.
scene: A view across an Indian college exam hall with rows of wooden desks, high windows, a ceiling fan and an invigilator in a sweater vest walking between rows. In the foreground, two students sit side by side. On the left, a young woman in a kurta with her hair in a plait has drawn a small neat diagram on rough paper, taps a few keys on a simple calculator and writes a short boxed answer with a green tick hovering beside it; she leans back calmly, her pen capped, a wall clock above showing plenty of time left. On the right, a young man in a checked shirt, sweating and wide-eyed, has filled his answer sheet with long strings of digits after a decimal point; his calculator screen shows a long precise number, he looks very pleased, but a large faint red cross hovers over the whole sheet. A dotted arrow from his blank rough paper, empty of any diagram, leads to the wrong answer. Bright morning light through tall windows, chalk dust in the air, tense exam atmosphere with a touch of humour.
