Labels: "UNDERSTANDING + TOOL" above the woman, "TOOL WITHOUT UNDERSTANDING" above the man, "FALSE PRECISION" beside his long number.

key: A sheepdog behind a flock walking uphill
name: ch15_sheepdog_parabolic_sar
alt: A sheepdog walks behind a flock moving up a hillside, closing in faster each time they reach new ground, and when the flock stalls it walks into them and they turn round.
scene: A wide side view of a green Himachal hillside with pine trees and terraced fields, the slope rising from left to right. A flock of white and brown sheep moves up the slope toward the right, led by an old shepherd in a grey woollen cap, a pattu shawl and a walking staff. Behind them, a black-and-white sheepdog follows, shown in a time-lapse of ghosted positions forming a dotted curve: at first it lags far behind on the lower slope, then each successive position is closer to the flock and steeper, the dots bending upward like an accelerating curve. Small arrows between the dog's positions grow longer to show it closing faster each time the flock reaches new ground. At the top right, the flock has stalled on a flat ledge, grazing, and the dog walks right into the back of them; an inset arrow shows the whole flock turning round to face downhill. A shepherd boy waves from a stone wall. Crisp mountain light with snow peaks in the distance, cool greens and blues, calm but purposeful mood. Labels: "PARABOLIC SAR" beside the dog's dotted curve, "ACCELERATION" beside the lengthening arrows, "STOP AND REVERSE" beside the turning flock.

key: Two teams in a tug of war
name: ch15_tug_of_war_adx_strength
alt: Two tug-of-war teams on a field: in one panel the rope wobbles at the centre in an even contest, in the other one team drags the other across the field.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing a tug-of-war on a school sports ground with a chalk centre line and a red ribbon tied at the middle of the rope. The team on the left wears green t-shirts and the team on the right wears red t-shirts in both panels. LEFT panel: the two teams strain evenly, the ribbon wobbling back and forth over the chalk line, with small zig-zag motion marks; a referee in a white shirt with a whistle looks bored, a small gauge beside him with its needle near the bottom. RIGHT panel: the green team leans back powerfully, gaining ground, and drags the red team far across the field, red team members stumbling and sliding on their heels, one falling on his back, the ribbon well past the green side's line; the referee now watches excitedly and the gauge beside him has its needle high. Small strength arrows above each team, green and red, show the green arrow much longer in the right panel. Schoolchildren cheer from a bench behind. Bright noon sun, energetic mood. Labels: "+DI VS -DI" above the teams, "ADX LOW" by the left gauge, "ADX HIGH" by the right gauge.

key: Cruise control. On an open motorway
name: ch15_cruise_control_highway_city
alt: A car on cruise control glides smoothly on an open highway, but in dense city traffic the same setting keeps pushing it toward the car in front.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing the same silver sedan from a rear three-quarter view, a driver in a light shirt with one hand resting loosely on the wheel and a small glowing cruise-control icon on the dashboard. LEFT panel: an open six-lane expressway through flat green fields with distant hills, very few vehicles, the car gliding steadily with a long smooth arrow ahead of it, the driver relaxed and humming. RIGHT panel: the same car in dense city traffic at a crowded junction, autorickshaws, buses, two-wheelers and a cow on the road, brake lights glowing red ahead; the car keeps edging forward with a jerky arrow pointing into the bumper of a bus in front, a small warning burst at the gap, the driver's face alarmed, leaning back. In an inset bubble at the top right of the right panel, a hand reaches for the dashboard switch with a small off symbol, showing a driver or sensor turning it off. Bright clear daylight on the left, hazy smoggy orange light on the right. Labels: "TRENDING MARKET" at the top of the left panel, "RANGE-BOUND MARKET" at the top of the right panel, "SWITCH OFF THE SYSTEM" beside the inset hand.

key: A ship with watertight compartments
name: ch16_ship_watertight_compartments
alt: A cut-away cargo ship with half its hull sealed as a reserve and the rest divided into small compartments, one leaking but contained.
scene: A side cut-away cross-section of a cargo ship sailing on a calm sea, drawn like a technical poster. The hull is divided by vertical bulkheads. The whole rear half of the hull is one large sealed compartment painted a calm blue, neatly stacked with locked steel strongboxes. The front half is split into several smaller compartments, each holding a modest stack of colourful cargo crates, none taller than about a tenth of the ship's total. Two neighbouring compartments are tinted the same shade and bracketed together. In one front compartment a small leak sprays water through a hole, and the water fills only the bottom of that compartment before stopping at a red line, the bulkheads keeping the rest dry. A ship's officer in a white uniform and cap stands on deck with a clipboard, calmly pointing at the bulkhead, while a young sailor in overalls holds a bucket. Seagulls fly overhead and a lighthouse stands far away on the horizon. Clear blue sky, crisp and reassuring mood. Labels: "50% RESERVE" over the large rear compartment, "MAX RISK PER TRADE" at the red line in the leaking compartment, "MARKET GROUP LIMIT" beside the bracketed pair.

key: A fisherman who loses three cheap lures
name: ch16_fisherman_lures_vs_big_fish
alt: A fisherman on a jetty has lost three cheap lures on snagged lines but proudly holds up one big fish worth far more than the lures.
scene: A view of a wooden fishing jetty on a backwater in Kerala at sunrise, coconut palms on the far bank and a houseboat drifting by. On the jetty, a fisherman in his 50s with a weathered face, a checked lungi, a white vest and a towel tied round his head grins proudly as he lifts a big silver fish with both hands, its tail curling. At his feet lies a small tackle box. Beside him, three broken fishing lines dangle into the water, each with a tiny cheap lure snagged on underwater weeds and rocks, small price tags floating above them reading "10", "10" and "10". Above the big fish floats a larger price tag reading "100". A simple balance scale is drawn on the jetty: three little lures on one pan rising high, the big fish on the other pan sinking low. A curious heron stands on a post nearby, and a small boy with a bucket watches admiringly. Soft pink and gold sunrise light with mist over the water, satisfied mood. Labels: "SMALL LOSSES" beside the three snagged lures, "ONE BIG WIN" beside the fish, "REWARD TO RISK" above the balance scale.

key: Two people in a car on a long trip
name: ch16_driver_and_passenger_units
alt: On a long highway trip, the driver keeps the car moving through traffic while the passenger hops out at a crowded junction to buy food and hops back in.
scene: A wide high-angle view of a crowded highway junction on the Mumbai-Pune route, with dhabas, a fruit stall, a vada pav cart and slow-moving traffic. In the centre, a white hatchback inches forward in a jam. The driver, a man in his 40s in a polo shirt and sunglasses, keeps both hands on the wheel, calm and patient, eyes on the road. The passenger, his friend in a kurta with a cloth bag, is shown in a ghosted time-lapse: first stepping out of the passenger door, then at a vada pav cart paying the vendor and grabbing two paper parcels, then hopping back into the car just as traffic starts moving. A dotted loop path traces the passenger's quick round trip from the car to the stall and back. A long straight solid arrow runs ahead of the car down the highway, unbroken. Truck drivers and a family in an autorickshaw wait around them. Bright midday sun, dusty and colourful, light-hearted mood. Labels: "TREND UNIT" above the driver, "TRADING UNIT" above the passenger's loop, "BOTH ARRIVE" beside the arrow ahead.

key: A pyramid stands because its base
name: ch16_pyramid_right_way_up
alt: A stable pyramid of stacked blocks with the largest at the bottom, beside an upside-down pyramid with the biggest block on top toppling at a small push.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves set on a sandy construction site with a simple scaffold in the background. LEFT panel: a stable pyramid of four sandstone blocks, the widest block at the bottom and each block above smaller, the top block tiny; a small worker in a hard hat and orange vest leans on it casually with a tea cup, and a gentle push arrow against its side has no effect. RIGHT panel: an upside-down stack, a tiny block at the bottom and each block above larger, the biggest one balanced at the very top; a small breeze arrow or a light push from a child's finger makes the whole stack wobble, and the huge top block is shown sliding off with motion lines and dust, the worker beside it leaping back in alarm. Beside each stack, a thin price scale on a post shows the top block positioned at the highest price. Bright sunny day, sandy yellows and blue sky, clear and slightly humorous mood. Labels: "BIG FIRST, SMALLER ADDS" at the top of the left panel, "SMALL FIRST, BIGGER ADDS" at the top of the right panel, "PYRAMIDING" centred along the bottom.

key: A row of dominoes, but some are linked
name: ch17_dominoes_with_seesaws
alt: A row of large dominoes linked by see-saws, where the dollar domino rising tips commodities down, which tips bonds up, which pulls stocks up.
scene: A wide side view of a long wooden table in a games room, with a chain of four oversized painted dominoes and see-saws arranged left to right. FIRST, a green domino rises upward on a lifting platform with an upward arrow. It is linked to a small see-saw: as its end goes up, the other end tips down, lowering the SECOND domino, painted gold and brown with tiny icons of an oil drop, a wheat ear and a metal bar. That domino rests on a second see-saw whose far end rises, lifting the THIRD domino, painted blue with a small scroll icon. The third domino is tied by a short string to the FOURTH, painted red with a small office tower icon, pulling it upward too. Curved motion arrows show each link. In a small inset at the bottom right, the string between the third and fourth dominoes is snapped, the third rising while the fourth falls, with a cracked ice and falling price-tag icon. A curious girl of about ten in a pinafore and her grandfather in a sweater watch from behind the table. Warm indoor lamp light, clear and playful mood. Labels: "DOLLAR" on the first domino, "COMMODITIES" on the second domino, "BONDS AND STOCKS" above the third and fourth.

key: the dog that hears the doorbell first
name: ch17_dog_hears_doorbell_first
alt: A dog leaps up and runs to the door at the first ring of the doorbell, while its owner on the sofa only begins to get up a few seconds later.
scene: A cosy medium shot of an Indian apartment living room with a sofa, a TV showing a cricket match, a coffee table with a plate of biscuits and a front door with a brass nameplate on the right. A ringing doorbell is drawn by the door with small sound waves. A golden-brown Labrador-like dog has already leapt off its rug in the centre of the room and is bounding toward the door, ears flapping, tail up, motion lines behind it, barking. On the sofa at the left, the owner, a man in his 40s in a vest and track pants holding the TV remote, is only beginning to lift himself up, half-risen, head turning slowly toward the door with a sleepy expression. A small timeline strip along the bottom shows a dog icon at the first tick and a person icon a few ticks later, with a short bracket between them. A wall clock shows a few seconds' difference with two hands highlighted. Warm evening indoor light, homely and humorous mood. Labels: "BONDS" above the dog, "STOCKS" above the owner, "LEAD TIME" beside the bracket on the timeline.

key: A local bakery and an exporter
name: ch17_bakery_vs_machine_exporter
alt: A neighbourhood bakery serving local customers is unaffected while a nearby machine exporter sees foreign orders shrink as the home currency strengthens.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, connected at the top by a single banner showing a rupee coin icon growing larger with an upward arrow. LEFT panel: a cheerful neighbourhood Iyengar-style bakery with glass jars of rusks and cakes, the baker in his 50s in a white apron and cap handing a bag of fresh bread to a local customer in a saree, a schoolboy pointing at puffs; the queue of local customers is as long as ever, and a small steady flat arrow floats above the shop. RIGHT panel: a factory showroom of an engineering firm with big lathe machines and gear wheels, the sales manager in a blazer standing beside a shipping container on a truck; a stack of foreign order sheets on his desk has shrunk to just two, and through a window a cargo ship sails away with only a few containers. A foreign buyer is shown in a small video call screen on his laptop frowning at a price tag that has gone up. A small downward arrow floats above the factory. Bright daylight on the left, slightly greyer light on the right. Labels: "STRONG HOME CURRENCY" on the top banner, "DOMESTIC FIRM" above the bakery, "EXPORTER" above the factory.

key: Two runners on treadmills that both
name: ch17_treadmills_relative_strength
alt: Two runners on treadmills in a gym that speed up and slow down together with the music, while a coach divides one's distance by the other's to see who is pulling ahead.
scene: A wide interior view of a busy neighbourhood gym in Bengaluru with mirrors, dumbbell racks and a large speaker on the wall pulsing with music notes. In the centre, two treadmills stand side by side. On the left, a young woman in a purple sports top and black leggings runs smoothly; on the right, a man in his 30s in a grey vest and shorts runs, slightly more red-faced. Both treadmill speed displays rise and fall together in sync with the music, shown by matching wavy arrows above both machines. Behind them, a coach in a tracksuit with a whistle and a clipboard holds up a small sheet showing a fraction: a woman icon over a man icon, with a single line rising steadily upward to the right beneath it. A dotted line from each treadmill display feeds into the clipboard. Other gym-goers lift weights in the background, and a water cooler stands by the wall. Bright fluorescent gym lighting with energetic music marks, focused and analytical mood. Labels: "MARKET MUSIC" beside the speaker, "RATIO" beside the fraction, "RELATIVE STRENGTH" above the coach's rising line.

key: Did the whole class improve
name: ch18_class_average_vs_breadth
alt: A teacher looks at a class whose average score rose, but only three top students scored full marks while most others did worse.
scene: A frontal view of an Indian school classroom with wooden benches, a green chalkboard and a fan overhead. At the front, a teacher in her 40s in a cotton saree and spectacles holds a marks register and looks thoughtfully at a bar graph pinned to the board where the class average bar has risen a little with a small up arrow. In the first row, three students in white uniforms stand proudly holding answer sheets with large "100" circled in red, beaming. Behind them, rows of students, more than twenty, slump at their desks holding answer sheets with lower marks, each with a small downward arrow floating above their heads, some looking glum, one resting his head on his arms. A curious student near the window holds up a hand with a tally count, raised fingers showing how many improved versus how many fell. A dotted bracket around the three toppers is marked as the source of the average's rise. Afternoon light through barred windows, dusty chalk air, reflective mood. Labels: "THE AVERAGE" beside the bar graph, "FEW LEADERS" above the toppers, "BREADTH" above the rows of students with down arrows.

key: A marching band where the drum major
name: ch18_drum_major_band_falling_apart
alt: A marching band where the drum major keeps striding forward while the rows behind him slow down and stop, seen from the front and from the side.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing the same Republic Day-style street parade with a brass band in red and white uniforms with plumed caps. LEFT panel, view from the front row of the audience: the drum major, a tall man in a sash and tall hat, strides forward toward the viewer twirling his mace confidently; behind him, the band appears as a solid tight block, and spectators on the kerb clap and cheer. RIGHT panel, view from the side of the street: the drum major has marched far ahead to the right with a long forward arrow, but behind him the rows have spread out and slowed, the trumpet players lagging, a drummer stopped to fix his strap, a clarinet player looking confused, the back rows standing still; gaps open between rows, marked with dotted measuring lines. A boy on a lamp post on the side has the best view and points at the gaps. Bright sunny morning with flags and bunting, festive then slightly comic mood. Labels: "INDEX" above the drum major, "ADVANCE-DECLINE LINE" above the lagging rows, "DIVERGENCE" beside the gaps.

key: TRIN compares how busy the average
name: ch18_trin_busy_tills
alt: Two shop cash counters side by side: a quiet till for rising shops and a mobbed till for falling shops where panicked sellers crowd in.
scene: A wide view of two neighbouring shop counters in a busy Indian wholesale market lane, each with a cash register, a calculator and a small marigold garland. Above the left counter, a green signboard bears an up arrow; above the right counter, a red signboard bears a down arrow. At the left counter, a calm shopkeeper in a white shirt serves only two relaxed customers, a woman with a cloth bag and an old man counting coins, the cash drawer barely open. At the right counter, a frantic crowd of sellers, men and women with worried faces, push forward holding up bundles of goods and paper slips, shouting to be served first; the shopkeeper there, sweating, punches the register rapidly while slips fly in the air and the cash drawer overflows. Above both counters, a balance beam on a hook compares the two crowds, tipping heavily toward the red side with a gauge needle jumping into the red. A stray goat wanders between the counters. Warm crowded market lighting with dust and colour, tense and hectic mood. Labels: "ADVANCING VOLUME" over the quiet left till, "DECLINING VOLUME" over the mobbed right till, "TRIN SPIKES" beside the gauge.

key: A crowd walking through a gate
name: ch18_gate_height_and_width
alt: Two crowds passing through a stadium gate: three people trickling through a narrow gate, and a broad stampede pushing through a wide gate.
scene: A split-panel illustration divided by a thin vertical line, both halves showing the entrance gate of a cricket stadium with high iron railings, ticket posters and a security guard in khaki. LEFT panel: a narrow side gate barely open, with only three spectators slipping through one by one, a man with a flag, a woman with a water bottle and a boy in a cap, while the large forecourt behind them stays empty; they walk a long way past the gate along a tall vertical dotted arrow. RIGHT panel: the main gate is flung wide open and a massive crowd surges through it shoulder to shoulder, waving flags, horns raised, confetti in the air, dust kicked up; a wide double-headed horizontal arrow spans the width of the surging crowd, and a tall vertical arrow beside it shows the same height of movement as on the left. The guard on the right is pressed against the railing with his hat askew. Bright late-afternoon sun with long shadows, sparse on the left and energetic on the right. Labels: "HOW FAR = PRICE" beside the vertical arrows, "HOW MANY = BREADTH" beside the wide horizontal arrow, "STRONG BREAKOUT" at the top of the right panel.

key: Temperature, blood pressure, an X-ray
name: ch19_doctor_combines_readings
alt: A doctor studies a thermometer reading, blood pressure, an X-ray and notes from the patient's story together to reach a diagnosis.
scene: A warm interior of a family doctor's consulting room in an Indian town, with a wooden desk, a lamp, an X-ray viewer box on the wall and a calendar. Behind the desk sits an experienced doctor in his 60s with silver hair, a stethoscope around his neck and a white coat over a checked shirt, his chin resting on his hand in thought. Spread on the desk in a semicircle are four pieces of evidence: a mercury thermometer, a blood-pressure cuff with a dial, a printed report, and a small notebook with handwritten notes. On the lightbox behind him glows a chest X-ray. In a chair opposite, the patient, a woman in her 40s in a salwar suit, talks with her hands, a speech bubble showing small icons of travel and fatigue. Thin dotted lines run from each piece of evidence and from her speech bubble toward a glowing puzzle piece above the doctor's head, where one odd-coloured piece clicks into place to complete the picture. A small potted tulsi plant sits on the window sill. Soft late-afternoon lamp light, calm and thoughtful mood. Labels: "ONE TOOL IS NOT ENOUGH" above the desk, "WEIGHT OF THE EVIDENCE" beside the glowing puzzle.

key: makes sure nothing obvious is skipped
name: ch19_pilot_preflight_checklist
alt: Two pilots in a cockpit run through a printed pre-flight checklist, ticking items one by one before take-off on a busy morning.
scene: A view from behind and between two pilots seated in an airliner cockpit at a busy Indian airport on a hazy morning, the windscreen showing the taxiway, a ground crew member with marshalling wands and other aircraft tails in the distance. On the left, the captain, a woman in her 40s with her hair in a neat bun, white shirt with four gold stripes on the epaulettes and a headset, holds a laminated checklist card and reads from it, her finger on the next line. On the right, the first officer, a younger man in his late 20s with three stripes, reaches up to a panel of switches above, confirming each item. The checklist card in her hand shows several rows with small tick boxes, most already ticked, one being ticked now. Thin dotted lines link a few rows on the card to the corresponding switches and gauges overhead. A coffee cup in a holder and a tablet clipped to the side add to the busy morning feel. In a small inset bubble at the top, a clock shows a tight departure time. Soft dawn light through the windscreen and glowing instrument panels, calm, disciplined mood. Labels: "THE CHECKLIST" beside the card, "DOES NOT FLY THE PLANE" beside the windscreen view.
